title: Share of all US firefighters who are volunteers

source.name: US Fire Department Profile
source.publisher: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), via National Volunteer Fire Council

notes: NFPA and NVFC data put volunteers at about 65% of all US firefighters as of the most recent count, protecting most of the country's land area and many of the small and rural communities with the fastest-growing call volumes. Verified live via web search 2026-11-11.
